signals.detail: 18 distinct design tells: icon-tile-stack, ai-violet, icon-tile-grid, glass-panel, thin-border-wide-shadow, radial-spotlight-glow, shadcn-dump, reflex-font-2, reflex-font, gradient-text, cream-palette, reveal-everywhere, italic-serif-display, grid-background, hero-then-proof, pill-everything, hero-eyebrow-chip, intro-cinematic
score 0.05, not typical of what Claude builds for this brief

actions.what: Write art-direction.json: run craft direction init, then give every choice a reason from the client's world.

Pick the display face from the client's world (signage, packaging, the trade's lettering) and record why in art-direction.json. If this face really is the right one, declare an exception with the reason and the evidence.
actions.why: Second-wave reflex font (reflex-font-2, gen 2), in source and on the page; Reflex font (reflex-font, gen 1); Italic serif display (italic-serif-display, gen 2)

actions.what: Use the client's own marks, photography or numerals. If an icon earns its place, set it inline with the text.
actions.why: Icon in a tinted tile (icon-tile-stack, gen 2); Glass panel (glass-panel, gen 1); Radial glow (radial-spotlight-glow, gen 2), in source and on the page; Graph-paper background (grid-background, gen 2)

actions.what: Follow the hero with the thing only this business has: the work, the place, the person. Put proof where a doubt arises.
actions.why: Hero straight into a trust strip (hero-then-proof, gen 1), in source and on the page

actions.what: Derive the accent from something the client owns (livery, shopfront, product). If violet is the brand, declare it: `{ "tell": "ai-violet", "because": "..." }`.
actions.why: Indigo-violet accent (ai-violet, gen 1); Gradient-filled heading (gradient-text, gen 1)

actions.what: Take the ground from the client's material world (paper stock, wall colour, tile). If it really is cream, say why.
Delete the primitives nothing imports. Restyle the ones that stay so they belong to this site.
actions.why: Stock component dump (shadcn-dump, gen 1); Pills everywhere (pill-everything, gen 1)

actions.what: Pick one: a border that is visible, or a shadow the light source explains. Keep within the four-shadow budget.
Keep one gated signature moment per page (STANDARD section 7) and let the rest arrive still. The limit here is 12 per scan.
actions.why: Reveal on every section (reveal-everywhere, gen 1); Intro cinematic (intro-cinematic, gen 2)

actions.what: Show the services as the client would: a price list, a menu board, photographs of the work, a sequence.
Drop it. If the fact matters, put it in the headline or the first line of copy.
actions.why: Eyebrow chip above the hero (hero-eyebrow-chip, gen 2)

actions.what: Keep the one that lands hardest and cut the rest. 'What is genuinely excellent' reads better as 'what is excellent'.
Replace it with the positive fact it hints at, or cut it.
Replace the phrase with the fact behind it: a number, a name, a place, a time.
Use a full stop, a comma, or a colon. Two sentences are clearer than one sentence with a dash in it.
Cut the phrase and start with the point it was introducing. 'Seamless booking' becomes 'Book in three taps'.
Say the plain thing. 'Elevate your look' becomes what actually happens: 'Gel that lasts three weeks'.
Open with the answer.
actions.why: Rhetorical question opener (rhetorical-opener), 29 places, first at apps/portal/app/account/page.tsx:310

actions.what: Say what is actually true. 'World-class service' becomes 'We answer the phone until 8pm'. 'Reach out' becomes 'get in touch'.
Say the positive claim and drop the contrast.
Remove it. Typographic marks are fine: a star for a rating, a middot as a separator, an arrow in a link.
actions.why: Emoji in copy (emoji), 327 places, first at apps/portal/components/booking/customerFormTypes.ts:25

actions.what: Replace it with the specific thing. 'Innovative solutions' becomes the actual product and what it does.
Write one sentence that says which of the three is true, and how you know.
Name the mechanism instead. 'Empower your team' becomes 'Your team can publish without us'.
actions.why: A plainer word exists (plainer-word), 6 places, first at apps/portal/lib/assistant/prompt.ts:13

actions.what: Say what the place is and where it is.
actions.why: 'Where X meets Y' (where-x-meets-y), 2 places, first at apps/portal/lib/content.ts:102

actions.what: Name the action and the outcome: 'Book a 45-minute facial', not 'Experience the difference'.
Say what they get: 'We reply within a day and only about your enquiry'.
actions.why: 'No X, no Y' list (no-x-no-y), 2 places, first at social/launch-pack/CAPTIONS.md:3
